obligations.requirement: PreviewModel keeps confirmed and replaceable predicted state with monotonic revisions and deterministic rollback.
obligations.oracle: Focused structural tests with independent expected point vectors and revisions.
obligations.acceptance: Confirmed points are never lost; new confirmed input removes prior prediction; cancel clears only transient state.

obligations.requirement: Arc unavailability or presentation failure switches to canonical-only without changing confirmed input or canonical candidate.
obligations.oracle: Fault-injected preview port records calls, failure, fallback and candidate digest.
obligations.acceptance: Fallback is sticky for the stroke and candidate equality is exact.

obligations.requirement: The bridge cannot emit CanonicalVisible or mutate canonical/runtime scene state.
obligations.oracle: API and symbol scan plus mutation-scope audit.
obligations.acceptance: No CanonicalVisible/PresentedProof/canonical write entrypoint exists in changed production code.
